ai_summary: Aarvi Encon Limited has secured a significant three-year work order from Mahanagar Gas Limited, valued at INR 30.63 Crores, for providing manpower services for CNG station operations. This domestic contract, effective from September 2026 to August 2029, is expected to materially boost revenue and strengthen the company's market presence in technical manpower services within the energy sector. No red flags were identified, as the transaction is confirmed to be at arm's length and not a related party deal.
